require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'securerandom'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'bcrypt'

module ImagePipeline
  ROLES = { admin: 3, editor: 2, viewer: 1 }.freeze
  ALLOWED_FORMATS = %w[png jpg gif webp].freeze
  MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024

  class AuditLogger
    def initialize(log_path)
      @logger = Logger.new(log_path)
      @logger.formatter = proc do |severity, datetime, progname, msg|
        "[#{datetime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}] #{severity} -- #{msg}\n"
      end
    end

    def log_action(user, action, details)
      sanitized_user = sanitize_field(user)
      sanitized_action = sanitize_field(action)
      sanitized_details = sanitize_field(details)
      @logger.info("user=#{sanitized_user} action=#{sanitized_action} details=#{sanitized_details}")
    end

    def log_processing(job_id, metadata)
      entry = format_metadata(job_id, metadata)
      @logger.info(entry)
    end

    private

    def sanitize_field(input)
      input.to_s.gsub(/[\r\n\t]/, ' ').gsub(/[^\x20-\x7E]/, '')
    end

    def format_metadata(job_id, metadata)
      parts = ["job=#{job_id}"]
      metadata.each do |key, value|
        encoded_key = sanitize_field(key.to_s)
        encoded_value = sanitize_field(encode_value(value))
        parts << "#{encoded_key}=#{encoded_value}"
      end
      parts.join(' ')
    end

    def encode_value(value)
      case value
      when Hash
        value.map { |k, v| "#{k}:#{v}" }.join(',')
      when Array
        value.join(',')
      else
        value.to_s.encode('UTF-8', invalid: :replace, undef: :replace)
      end
    end
  end

  class AccessControl
    def initialize
      @permissions = {
        upload: :editor,
        process: :editor,
        delete: :admin,
        view: :viewer,
        audit: :admin
      }
    end

    def authorized?(user_role, action)
      required = @permissions[action.to_sym]
      return false unless required
      ROLES[user_role.to_sym].to_i >= ROLES[required].to_i
    end
  end

  class ImageProcessor
    def initialize(audit_logger)
      @audit = audit_logger
      @access = AccessControl.new
      @jobs = {}
    end

    def submit_job(user, role, params)
      unless @access.authorized?(role, :process)
        @audit.log_action(user, 'denied', 'insufficient permissions for process')
        return { error: 'Forbidden', status: 403 }
      end

      job_id = SecureRandom.uuid
      format = params[:format].to_s.downcase

      unless ALLOWED_FORMATS.include?(format)
        @audit.log_action(user, 'rejected', "invalid format: #{format}")
        return { error: 'Invalid format', status: 400 }
      end

      metadata = build_metadata(user, params)
      @audit.log_processing(job_id, metadata)

      @jobs[job_id] = { user: user, status: :queued, metadata: metadata }
      { job_id: job_id, status: :queued }
    end

    def get_job_status(user, role, job_id)
      unless @access.authorized?(role, :view)
        return { error: 'Forbidden', status: 403 }
      end

      job = @jobs[job_id]
      return { error: 'Not found', status: 404 } unless job
      return { error: 'Forbidden', status: 403 } unless job[:user] == user || role.to_sym == :admin

      { job_id: job_id, status: job[:status] }
    end

    private

    def build_metadata(user, params)
      meta = {
        submitted_by: user,
        format: params[:format],
        dimensions: params[:dimensions] || 'original',
        quality: (params[:quality] || 85).to_i.clamp(1, 100),
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601
      }

      if params[:exif_comment]
        meta[:comment] = params[:exif_comment]
      end

      if params[:watermark_text]
        meta[:watermark] = params[:watermark_text]
      end

      meta
    end
  end
end

audit = ImagePipeline::AuditLogger.new('pipeline_audit.log')
processor = ImagePipeline::ImageProcessor.new(audit)

post '/api/v1/jobs' do
  content_type :json
  auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
  halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless auth_header

  user, role = authenticate(auth_header)
  halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless user

  params_data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
  result = processor.submit_job(user, role, params_data)

  status result[:status] || 200
  result.to_json
end

get '/api/v1/jobs/:id' do
  content_type :json
  auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
  halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless auth_header

  user, role = authenticate(auth_header)
  halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless user

  result = processor.get_job_status(user, role, params[:id])
  status result[:status] || 200
  result.to_json
end

def authenticate(header)
  # Token-based auth lookup (simplified)
  token = header.to_s.sub(/^Bearer\s+/, '')
  # In production, verify against secure token store
  session = $token_store&.dig(token)
  return nil unless session
  [session[:user], session[:role]]
end
